dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well... what are you planning to teach him?

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: For now, I don't intend to teach him anything. In a few days, I plan to give him several books. Not the grand treatises on commerce he most wishes to read and imitate, of course, but a few novels.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: In those novels, there are those who willingly set foot upon a misguided path, those who cross blades with their own brothers, and those who pity all mankind, only to discover in the end that there is no one who can save them...

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: Dear Knyazev, young Knyazev. Look upon them, and then go in search of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: ...Believe me. The most important thing in one's life is to find their true self.
